episodes.synopsis: Alina became a guild receptionist because she thought it'd be an easy, safe, secure job. However, in reality, she's so swamped with work that she's stuck pulling overtime day after day... and she's had enough!
episodes.title: I'm a Guild Receptionist, so I Want a Peaceful Life

episodes.synopsis: Jade has found out that Alina is the Executioner and hounds her to join Silver Sword. Then a certain adventurer with a grudge sets a raid boss loose...
episodes.title: I May Be the Executioner, but I'll Be Fired if People Find Out, so I'll Have to Use Force

episodes.synopsis: Glen has learned Alina's secret and proposes a duel. If she loses, she must go to the Chalk Tower with Silver Sword.
episodes.title: I May Be Silver Sword's Tank, but I Want to Take On a Really Tough Dungeon

episodes.synopsis: The guiding crystal Jade gave Alina starts to glow, signaling that he's in peril, so Alina rushes to help.
episodes.title: Relics, Secret Quests, and Dark Gods Keep Interfering with My Work, so I'll Destroy Them All

episodes.synopsis: Even after nursing Jade and Lowe back to health, Lululee is depressed over the loss of her weapon and skills.
episodes.title: I May Be Silver Sword's Healer, but Even I Could Use Some Healing

episodes.synopsis: Alina and Silver Sword go undercover to find the source of the rumor about relics that grant Dia skills.
episodes.title: I May Be Silver Sword's Back Attacker, but I'm Gonna Catch the Jerk Who Started That Rumor

episodes.synopsis: While Alina finally enjoys her first Centennial Festival, Lululee confronts the shadows of her past.
episodes.title: I've Waited Forever for the Centennial Festival, so I'm Gonna Enjoy It, No Matter What

episodes.synopsis: As Alina and Jade struggle in battle against a dark god, Lululee questions her role as a healer.
episodes.title: I May Be a Useless Healer, but I'm Going to Do Everything I Can

episodes.synopsis: Alina attends new-employee training in hopes of learning how she can avoid working overtime ever again.
episodes.title: I May Be in My Third Year as a Guild Receptionist, but I'm Starting New-Employee Training

episodes.synopsis: Jade suspects that the "man in black" who's been luring adventurers into danger is someone he knows very well.
episodes.title: A Ghost May Show Up During Training, but Nobody Told Me About It

episodes.synopsis: Deep beneath guild HQ, Alina and Silver Sword find the "man in black," who finally reveals his identity.
episodes.title: It May Be a Trap, but I Have to Keep Moving Forward

episodes.synopsis: Glen attacks Alina and Silver Sword ruthlessly, but they still cling to the hope of saving him.
episodes.title: I May Be a Guild Receptionist, But I'll Fight to the Bitter End to Get Out of Working Overtime
